from calendar_core.slots import Event, free_slots, overlaps, parse_time, fmt_duration


def test_issue_unsorted_order():
    """Events may arrive in any order."""
    result = free_slots([Event(720, 780), Event(540, 600)], 480, 1020)
    assert result == [(480, 540), (600, 720), (780, 1020)]  # 480=8*60, 540=9*60, 600=10*60, 720=12*60, 780=13*60, 1020=17*60


def test_issue_overlapping_nested():
    """Events may overlap each other."""
    result = free_slots([Event(540, 700), Event(600, 650)], 480, 800)
    assert result == [(480, 540), (700, 800)]  # 480=8*60, 540=9*60, 700=11*60+40, 800=13*60+20


def test_issue_chain_overlap_unsorted():
    """Events may arrive in any order and may overlap each other."""
    result = free_slots([Event(650, 750), Event(540, 620), Event(600, 700)], 480, 800)
    assert result == [(480, 540), (750, 800)]  # merged busy 540-750; gaps 540-480=60 and 800-750=50


def test_issue_clip_before_day():
    """Events partly outside the day are clipped to it."""
    result = free_slots([Event(400, 550)], 480, 1020)
    assert result == [(550, 1020)]  # clipped busy 480-550 (max(400,480)=480); gap 1020-550=470


def test_issue_clip_after_day():
    """Events partly outside the day are clipped to it."""
    result = free_slots([Event(900, 1100)], 480, 1020)
    assert result == [(480, 900)]  # clipped busy 900-1020 (min(1100,1020)=1020); gap 900-480=420


def test_issue_ignore_outside_day():
    """Events entirely outside the day are ignored."""
    result = free_slots([Event(0, 480), Event(1020, 1200)], 480, 1020)
    assert result == [(480, 1020)]  # 480=8*60, 1020=17*60; touching bounds cover 0 minutes, gap 1020-480=540


def test_issue_min_minutes_filters():
    """Only gaps of at least min_minutes are returned."""
    result = free_slots([Event(540, 700)], 480, 800, 61)
    assert result == [(700, 800)]  # gaps 540-480=60 and 800-700=100; 60<61<=100 so only second kept


def test_issue_empty_events():
    """Gaps inside [day_start, day_end) not covered by any event."""
    result = free_slots([], 480, 1020)
    assert result == [(480, 1020)]  # 480=8*60, 1020=17*60; gap 1020-480=540


def test_contract_back_to_back_no_overlap():
    """Back-to-back events (one ends exactly when the next starts) do not overlap."""
    assert overlaps(Event(540, 600), Event(600, 660)) is False  # 540=9*60, 600=10*60, 660=11*60; shared minutes: none


def test_contract_shared_minute_overlaps():
    """Two events overlap only if they share at least one minute."""
    assert overlaps(Event(540, 600), Event(590, 660)) is True  # 540=9*60, 590=9*60+50, 600=10*60; shared 590-599


def test_contract_back_to_back_leaves_no_gap():
    """An Event covers the half-open interval [start, end)."""
    result = free_slots([Event(540, 600), Event(600, 660)], 480, 720)
    assert result == [(480, 540), (660, 720)]  # 480=8*60, 540=9*60, 660=11*60, 720=12*60; no gap at 600


def test_contract_parse_time():
    """parse_time turns HH:MM (24-hour) into minutes."""
    assert parse_time("09:30") == 570  # 9*60+30=570


def test_contract_fmt_duration():
    """fmt_duration renders Xh YYm (e.g. 65 -> 1h 05m)."""
    assert fmt_duration(65) == "1h 05m"  # 65=1*60+5 -> 1h 05m
